measurement.note: In-process SQLite measurement through app.request(). It isolates the route from PostgreSQL, network transfer and serialization cost, and it is not a production measurement.

commits.note: Both runs used the same script and the same mock OpenViking read delay. Re-run on the parent commit in a separate checkout to reproduce the before row.

acceptance.note: The 700ms mock is the single-read floor measured on 209. Production p95 (13.87s) was far worse than this floor because 138-146 concurrent content/read calls inflate each individual read; the local harness therefore measures the best case the old route could reach, and the old route still missed the target by 3.5x.
